author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
Want a good drink? Checkout Holy here http://uk.holy.com/brit

Welcome to Ghost Recon Wildlands a lovely open world ubisoft game where you and a team of skilled operatives are sent in to defeat an evil cartel. We are not doing that instead each player has 1 hour to defeat as many targets as possible. This could be civilians or gang members. They all count as one point. So today I am joined by Hazzor, Reggie and Martincitopants all on a quest to see who can get the highest score in 1 hour. 

A big thank you to @HazzorPlaysGames @ReggieGames and @martincitopants for agreeing to participate in this nonsense for free. please show them some support and enjoy their warcrimes
